It should read 100% or “Full.” | Confirms you didn’t miss anything. | --- ### Locking Doors & Setting Parking Brake After topping off the tank, here’s how to make sure everything’s secured: | Action | Command / Manual Steps | Notes | |--------|-----------------------|-------| | **Lock All Doors** | • On‑board: Press the *lock* button on the key fob or inside the cabin.
